summary: Verified iteration_24 additions on Web Dojo: (1) Layers Effect Filter (layers-filter-fx) hides non-effect rows and shows layers-filter-empty when nothing carries an effect; (2) Copy/Paste now carries Shape styling (border-radius + box-shadow) along with Text FX from the ROOT tag; (3) Plain-background-only root is NOT copyable and leaves paste disabled. Zero console/page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: TextEffectsPanel: `background` is included in COPY_PROPS/SHAPE_PROPS with a neutral check that only filters 'none'/'transparent'/'initial'/rgba(0,0,0,0); a solid non-neutral background (e.g. #ffffff) IS copied. The 'meaningful' guard excludes 'background' from counting alone, but on paste it's still applied. Verify this matches product intent — paste currently overwrites destination background if source has one alongside another shape prop.

LayersPanel: fxOf regex `${prop}\s*:` allows substring shadow matches inside larger property names (though current props end with unique tokens, it's fragile). Consider word-boundary anchoring similar to rootStyleMap parsing.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral canvas blocks (Large Header x3, later a fresh Large Header) added/removed within the session via reload.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
